title: afl-cassowire configuration
description:
Configuration file for afl-cassowire, the persistent-mode network proxy for afl-fuzz.

The loader (src/config.cpp) rejects unknown keys at every level, so additionalProperties is false throughout. YAML anchors and aliases work (e.g. `network_cmplog: *net`); merge keys (`<<`) are NOT supported by yaml-cpp. Scalar types are strict: ports/timeouts must be unquoted integers and booleans must be true/false. Note that JSON Schema cannot distinguish `!!binary` tagged scalars from plain strings, so payload prefix/suffix are modeled as strings.

target_cmplog.description: Compare-mode target, used instead of `target` when __AFL_CMPLOG_SHM_ID is set. Standalone: no key falls back to `target`. Ignored and not validated unless afl.enable_cmplog is true, in which case this section is required.

network_cmplog.description: Compare-mode network, used instead of `network` when __AFL_CMPLOG_SHM_ID is set. Standalone: no key falls back to `network` (the cmplog target may listen on a different port). To reuse the whole section unchanged: `network_cmplog: *net`. Ignored and not validated unless afl.enable_cmplog is true, in which case this section is required.

args.description: Full argv passed to execve; argv[0] goes first. When omitted, defaults to a single-element argv [binary]. When present it must be non-empty: an empty list is rejected by the loader.

env.description: Environment variables set for the target process (string -> string).

env_preserve.description: Parent environment inheritance: "nothing" (no vars), "afl_only" (PATH, __AFL_SHM_ID, __AFL_CMPLOG_SHM_ID, ___AFL_EINS_ZWEI_POLIZEI___), or "all" (entire parent environment).

host.description: TCP host to connect to. Only IPv4 dotted literals work at connect time (the client uses inet_pton with AF_INET); hostnames and IPv6 literals are accepted here but will fail to connect.

port.description: TCP port to connect to (required, 1-65535). Must match the port the target binds; port detection confirms this configured port.

probe.description: Post-response quiescence probe: after each response, open a throwaway connection and wait until the target services it (data/EOF/RST). Catches crashes in post-response cleanup within the same iteration. Disable for targets that rate-limit connections or cannot tolerate an extra short-lived connection.

probe_retry_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between probe retries when the first probe fails. Set to 0 for no delay (the loader default).

enable_cmplog.description: Enable AFL compare log (requires __AFL_CMPLOG_SHM_ID). When true, the target_cmplog and network_cmplog sections become required.

primary.description: Port detection method: "procfs" (scan /proc, cannot detect a dead target), "ptrace", or "seccomp". Note for QEMU mode: ptrace/seccomp attach to the QEMU backend process and fight its internal threads, so procfs is required there.

defork.description: seccomp only: cancel every non-thread fork()/vfork()/clone() inside the target in-kernel (SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO|0), so the target runs de-forked: worker "child" code executes in the caller. Threads (clone with CLONE_THREAD) are unaffected. clone3() is not trapped. Requires primary: "seccomp".

force_kill_ms.description: Wait time after SIGTERM before SIGKILL (whole process group).

kill_pattern.description: Auto-kill stale target processes at startup. Scalar form: process name matched against /proc/<pid>/comm (the kernel truncates comm to 15 characters; a longer comm can never match). Object form: {type: "comm"|"regexp", value: <pattern>, target: "comm"|"argv0"|"argv" (meaningful for regexp)}. WARNING: the object form currently has a known loader bug (config.cpp parses `type` after the unknown-key check), so the `target` key is always rejected and `type: regexp` cannot load yet; the schema therefore accepts any object until that is fixed.

payload_section.description: Optional prefix/suffix wrapped around every payload sent to the target (in `proxy` and `test` mode): the transmitted data is prefix + fuzz input + suffix. Values may be plain strings or YAML `!!binary` base64-encoded bytes (a YAML tag, which JSON Schema cannot see - tagged scalars appear as plain strings here). Omit the section or a key to send the payload unmodified. A null section is accepted and treated as empty.

bytes_value.description: Raw bytes: plain string or YAML !!binary tagged scalar (base64-decoded by the loader).
